title: A Delay at the Ferry Gate
story: The ferry to the island was already late when Dina reached the gate. A board said the new time was two hours later. Dina had a paper ticket and a small backpack. She asked a staff member named Colin what to do. He stamped her ticket and pointed to a waiting room with seats and a kettle. Dina sent a message to the guesthouse so they would not worry. She ate an apple and read a map of the island paths. When the ferry arrived, Colin called her group first. The water was calm, and the ride took forty minutes. Dina stood on deck and watched the harbour.
